pages.text: $(l)Seeking Immortals$() is a mortal-path cultivation mod. Progress through spiritual power, realms, roots, lifespan, methods, pills, talismans, stones, artifacts, markets and secret realms.

pages.title: Core Loop
pages.text: Early play is root testing, meditation, cultivation exp, spiritual recovery and manual breakthroughs. Stones fund trade, pills support training and recovery, talismans and spells cover early combat.

pages.title: What is Live
pages.text: This book covers stones, pills, talismans, methods, alchemy/refinement, station operations, the delivery outbox, consumable semantics, companion growth, sect specialties, secret realms, regions and markets. JEI optionally shows three authority recipe classes.

pages.title: Sources
pages.text: Pages track text materials and runtime catalogs. Implemented behavior is labeled honestly; art and human multiplayer sign-off stay separate from gameplay gaps.

pages.title: Reading Order
pages.text: Start with realms, stones, pills, talismans and methods; then station operations, outbox and JEI; then secret realms, sect specialties and regional entries.
